name: Banneret

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: A knight whose leadership helps companions recover and seize opportunities.

feature.name: Well Spoken
feature.summary: Choose proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Performance.
feature.text: Choose proficiency in Insight, Intimidation, Persuasion, or Performance.

feature.name: Knightly Envoy
feature.summary: Comprehend Languages as a Ritual with Charisma; learn one language.
feature.text: You can cast Comprehend Languages as a Ritual, using Charisma. You also learn one language. (The book lets you swap it after a Long Rest for one you've heard, read or seen signed in the last day; in the game you pick it when you take the feature.)

feature.name: Group Recovery
feature.summary: When Second Wind heals you, also heal up to Charisma modifier allies (minimum 1) within a 30-foot Emanation for 1d4 + Fighter level each. Once per Short or Long Rest.
feature.text: When Second Wind heals you, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) allies within 30 feet also regain 1d4 + your Fighter level Hit Points (the most hurt first). Once per Short or Long Rest; it happens on its own unless you turn it Off in the class tab.
feature.policy_cost: Once per Short or Long Rest

feature.name: Team Tactics
feature.summary: Allies chosen for Group Recovery also gain Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn starts.
feature.text: Allies chosen for Group Recovery also gain Advantage on D20 Tests until your next turn starts.

feature.name: Rallying Surge
feature.summary: When using Action Surge, choose up to Charisma modifier allies (minimum 1) within a 30-foot Emanation. Each can immediately spend a Reaction to make a weapon or Unarmed Strike attack, or move half its Speed without Opportunity Attacks.
feature.text: When you use Action Surge, up to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) allies within 30 feet can each spend a Reaction to make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike (in the game: each ally with an enemy in reach attacks the nearest one). It happens on its own unless you turn it Off in the class tab.

feature.name: Shared Resilience
feature.summary: Reaction when a visible ally within 60 feet fails a save: spend Indomitable to let the ally reroll with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; it must keep the new roll.
feature.text: When an ally you can see within 60 feet fails a saving throw, you can take a Reaction and spend a use of Indomitable to let it reroll with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; it must use the new roll. In a fight it's off until you set it to Automatic in the class tab.
feature.policy_cost: Your Reaction and a use of Indomitable

feature.name: Unshakable Bravery
feature.summary: You are immune to Charmed and Frightened.
feature.text: You are immune to Charmed and Frightened.

feature.name: Bolstered Rally
feature.summary: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge now reach a 60-foot Emanation.
feature.text: Group Recovery and Rallying Surge now reach a 60-foot Emanation.
